FULL SPEAKING ASSESSMENT

IELTS Academic Speaking

Examiner-led mock interview · Parts 1–3 · automatic turn-taking · about 11–14 minutes.

How this mock works

  1. The examiner asks each question out loud.
  2. After a short beep, recording starts automatically.
  3. Speak your answer naturally.
  4. When you stop speaking, the examiner moves to the next question.
  5. If you have finished early, press I've finished.
Mock mode: you cannot repeat or change an answer. Use headphones and a quiet room.

The three parts

Part 1 · Interview4–5 min

Questions about you and familiar topics. Aim for 2–4 sentences: answer, reason, example.

Part 2 · Long turn3–4 min

A cue card, 1 minute to prepare with notes, then speak for 1–2 minutes.

Part 3 · Discussion4–5 min

Wider questions linked to Part 2. Give opinions, explain and speculate.

Choose a speaking test

Microphone check

Please Allow microphone access when the browser asks.

  1. Stay quiet for 2 seconds so we can measure the background noise in your room.
  2. Then say your full name and one sentence about today.
  3. Play it back and check that it sounds clear.
